'''Kerstin Thiele''' (born 26 August 1986, in [[Riesa]], [[Bezirk Dresden]], [[East Germany]]) is a German [[judoka]] and a silver medallist at the [[Judo at the 2012 Summer Olympics – Women's 70 kg|Olympic Games 2012]] in London.<ref>{{cite web |url=http://www.london2012.com/athlete/thiele-kerstin-1103836/ |title=Kerstin Thiele |work=[[London 2012 Olympics]] |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20120728034207/http://www.london2012.com/athlete/thiele-kerstin-1103836/ |archive-date=28 July 2012}}</ref><ref>{{cite Sports-Reference}}</ref>

Kerstin Thiele is a German champion in judo in the Middleweight ({{nbnd}}70&nbsp;kg) division.  She competes for the German club ''JC Leipzig'', and was part of the German national team.

At the 2012 Olympics she reached the women's middleweight judo final vs. [[Lucie Décosse]], who won the gold medal.  On the way Thiele beat [[Moira de Villiers]], [[Anett Mészáros|Anett Meszaros]], [[Edith Bosch]] and [[Chen Fei (judoka)|Chen Fei]].<ref>{{Cite web |url=http://www.olympic.org/olympic-results/london-2012/judo/63-70kg-middleweight-w |title=63 - 70kg (middleweight) women results - Judo - London 2012 Olympics |website=Olympic.org |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20150924172707/http://www.olympic.org/olympic-results/london-2012/judo/63-70kg-middleweight-w |archive-date=24 September 2015 |access-date=29 March 2016}}</ref>
